name: Voxel Raycast (Nonzero/Color Channel)
aliases: Hidden Surface Elimination via Ray Casting
definition: Performs a voxel raycast that stops at the first voxel where a specific channel value is non-zero.
summary: Voxel Raycast (Nonzero/Color Channel) performs hidden surface elimination by efficiently skipping empty byte-packed regions to find the first non-zero voxel in a binary volume.
